leader.title: President of the Council of Ministers

election._note: By law no later than 22 December 2027; Wikipedia 'Next Italian general election'. Rosatellum's ~61% PR / ~37% single-member split reduced to 'parallel' — see docs/electoral-systems.md.

dissolution._note: Art. 88: the President may dissolve either chamber (typically on the PM's advice after a lost confidence vote or a collapsed coalition), except during the semestre bianco -- the last six months of the President's own seven-year term, when dissolution is barred outright. Elections follow within 70 days. Wikipedia, 'Semestre bianco'.

head_of_state._note: The President of the Republic, elected by Parliament for a seven-year term; last elected January 2022, so the next is due January 2029. Whose own clock the head_of_state_limited semestre bianco is measured against -- see docs/dissolution-model.md. Wikipedia, 'President of Italy'.
head_of_state.title: President of the Republic

amendment._note: Art. 138: an amendment needs an absolute majority in each chamber in a first vote, then in a second vote three months later either a 2/3 majority in each chamber (final, no referendum) or an absolute majority (open to a referendum petition). This game models only the higher, referendum-proof bar, and only a single vote rather than two readings. senato.it, 'The revision of the Constitution'.
amendment._referendum_note: Art. 138: where the second vote carries by an absolute rather than a 2/3 majority, the amendment is open to a confirmatory referendum on petition. Modelled as the head of state's own choice rather than as a petition, since this game has no petition mechanic. senato.it, 'The revision of the Constitution'.
amendment._permits_system_change_note: Art. 139: 'The republican form of government shall not be subject to constitutional amendment.'

formation._note: PM appointed by the President of the Republic, then must win a confidence vote in both chambers. No confidence is simple -- no successor required. Art. 94 of the Constitution.
formation.head_of_government_title: President of the Council of Ministers

government._pretender_note: Whom data/laws/amendments.json's Restoration Act puts on the throne. Authored per nation because the law is generic and the dynasty is not; a monarchy points this at its own sitting monarch.

fiscal._note: General government, IMF/OECD estimates ~2023-2024, rounded. V1.2a starting policy, derived from France's anchor (see FRA.json): VAT 22% is Italy's own statutory standard rate (Tax Foundation, 'VAT Rates in Europe 2024'). Income and corporate (IRES plus average IRAP) are France's 20/25 scaled by Italy's OECD Revenue Statistics personal/corporate tax-to-GDP share against France's. Spending is France's split scaled by general government expenditure of 50.4% of GDP against France's 57.3% (TheGlobalEconomy.com / OECD Government at a Glance 2025).
